label: Town of Townshend
header:
# Town of Townshend municipal roster backfill -- Vermont
# municipal fan-out batch 23; issue #163 (VT master tracking).

sources.note: 17 V.S.A. section 2646: towns elect a moderator for a one-year term
Town of Townshend, signed minutes of the annual town meeting of March 3, 2026 (town website): David Liebow was re-elected Moderator
17 V.S.A. section 2646: towns elect a town clerk; Townshend elects its clerk to one-year terms
Town of Townshend, signed minutes of the annual town meeting of March 3, 2026 (town website): Ellenka Wilson was elected Town Clerk
Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Guide to Vermont's Town Clerks, Treasurers, and County Officials' (January 2026): lists Ellenka Wilson as Townshend's Town Clerk
Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, town clerk contact spreadsheet (updated June 12, 2026): names Ellenka Wilson as Townshend's Town Clerk
17 V.S.A. section 2646: towns elect a town treasurer

Town of Townshend, signed minutes of the annual town meeting of March 3, 2026 (town website): the Guide's Elaine Hill declined the nomination at the 2026 meeting and Elisha Stratford was elected Town Treasurer

Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Guide to Vermont's Town Clerks, Treasurers, and County Officials' (January 2026): lists Elaine Hill as Townshend's Town Treasurer -- stale; the 2026 minutes govern (see the minutes note)
Town of Townshend official website, Selectboard page: names Nick Suarez (Chair), Catherine Marrow (Vice Chair), Rob Wright, Alene Evans, and Steve Frisk
Town of Townshend, signed minutes of the annual town meeting of March 3, 2026 (town website): Catherine Marrow, Rob Wright, and Steve Frisk won the three 2026 seats
17 V.S.A. section 2646: towns elect three listers on staggered three-year terms

Town of Townshend official website, Listers page: names Mike Bills, Helen Holt, and Eugene Kuch (Holt is a different person from Brookline's appointed lister of the same name -- listers must reside in the town they serve)
Town of Townshend, signed minutes of the annual town meeting of March 3, 2026 (town website): Eugene Kuch won the 2026 three-year lister seat

sources.note: 17 V.S.A. section 2646: towns elect a collector of delinquent taxes
Town of Townshend, signed minutes of the annual town meeting of March 3, 2026 (town website): Becky Nystrom Reilly was elected Collector of Delinquent Taxes
17 V.S.A. section 2646: towns elect constables
Town of Townshend, signed minutes of the annual town meeting of March 3, 2026 (town website): Warren Beattie was elected First Constable
17 V.S.A. section 2646: towns elect constables
Town of Townshend, signed minutes of the annual town meeting of March 3, 2026 (town website): Mike Cutts was elected Second Constable
Town of Townshend official website, Library Trustees page: names Sandy Glaser, Miriam Schuldenfrei, Katherine Dugrenier, Judy Slowik, and Elizabeth Brown
Town of Townshend, signed minutes of the annual town meeting of March 3, 2026 (town website): Sandy Glaser won the 2026 five-year seat after Marilee Attley declined
Town of Townshend official website, Cemetery Commission page: names Scott Nystrom, Tim Massucco, Jay Warren, Charles Marchant, and Paula Newton

Town of Townshend, 2026 Town Report, Warning for the annual town meeting (town website): the warning sets five-year staggered terms (Nystrom to 2031, Newton to 2030, Massucco to 2029, Warren to 2028, Marchant to 2027); Massucco was elected to the remainder of departed member Bruce Bills's seat and Jay Warren, first appointed to his seat, was elected to its remainder
Town of Townshend official website, Planning Commission page: names Doug Ballentine (Chair), John Evans, and Rick Matschke

Town of Townshend, 2026 Town Report, Warning for the annual town meeting (town website): the warning elects planning commissioners under 24 V.S.A. section 4323 (Ballentine to 2028, Evans to 2027, Matschke to 2030); the two seats warned in 2026 (a five-year seat and a three-years-remaining seat) have no winners recorded in the minutes
